list.name: color
list.label: Color
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT workpiece_type FROM shopfloor_event WHERE workpiece_type IN (N'WHITE', N'RED', N'BLUE') AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT workpiece_type FROM shopfloor_event WHERE workpiece_type IN (N'WHITE', N'RED', N'BLUE') AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1

list.name: nfc
list.label: NFC
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT workpiece_id FROM shopfloor_event WHERE workpiece_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND (N'__ALL__' IN (${color:sqlstring}) OR workpiece_type IN (${color:sqlstring})) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT TOP 2000 CAST(ts AS datetime2) AS time, CONCAT(workpiece_id, N' · ', COALESCE(NULLIF(workpiece_type, N''), N'?')) AS metric, CONCAT(CASE WHEN topic LIKE N'fts/%' OR module_type = N'FTS' THEN N'FTS' WHEN module_serial = N'SVR4H73275' OR module_type = N'DPS' THEN N'DPS' WHEN module_serial = N'SVR3QA0022' OR module_type = N'HBW' THEN N'HBW' WHEN module_serial = N'SVR4H76449' OR module_type = N'DRILL' THEN N'DRILL' WHEN module_serial = N'SVR3QA2098' OR module_type = N'MILL' THEN N'MILL' WHEN module_serial = N'SVR4H76530' OR module_type IN (N'AIQS', N'QUALITY') THEN N'AIQS' ELSE COALESCE(module_type, N'—') END, N' / ', ISNULL(action, N'')) AS value FROM shopfloor_event WHERE workpiece_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND action_state = N'FINISHED' AND (topic LIKE N'module/%' OR topic LIKE N'fts/%' OR (topic = N'ccu/order/completed' AND action IN (N'MANUFACTURE', N'completed'))) AND (N'__ALL__' IN (${nfc:sqlstring}) OR workpiece_id IN (${nfc:sqlstring})) AND (N'__ALL__' IN (${color:sqlstring}) OR workpiece_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT s.workpiece_id FROM shopfloor_event s WHERE s.workpiece_type IN (${color:sqlstring}) AND s.workpiece_id IS NOT NULL AND s.ts >= $__timeFrom() AND s.ts <= $__timeTo())) ORDER BY ts

SELECT TOP 500 CAST(ts AS datetime2) AS ts, workpiece_id AS nfc, workpiece_type AS color, CASE WHEN topic LIKE N'fts/%' OR module_type = N'FTS' THEN N'FTS' WHEN module_serial = N'SVR4H73275' OR module_type = N'DPS' THEN N'DPS' WHEN module_serial = N'SVR3QA0022' OR module_type = N'HBW' THEN N'HBW' WHEN module_serial = N'SVR4H76449' OR module_type = N'DRILL' THEN N'DRILL' WHEN module_serial = N'SVR3QA2098' OR module_type = N'MILL' THEN N'MILL' WHEN module_serial = N'SVR4H76530' OR module_type IN (N'AIQS', N'QUALITY') THEN N'AIQS' ELSE COALESCE(module_type, N'—') END AS station, action, action_state, order_id FROM shopfloor_event WHERE workpiece_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND action_state = N'FINISHED' AND (topic LIKE N'module/%' OR topic LIKE N'fts/%' OR (topic = N'ccu/order/completed' AND action IN (N'MANUFACTURE', N'completed'))) AND (N'__ALL__' IN (${nfc:sqlstring}) OR workpiece_id IN (${nfc:sqlstring})) AND (N'__ALL__' IN (${color:sqlstring}) OR workpiece_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT s.workpiece_id FROM shopfloor_event s WHERE s.workpiece_type IN (${color:sqlstring}) AND s.workpiece_id IS NOT NULL AND s.ts >= $__timeFrom() AND s.ts <= $__timeTo())) ORDER BY ts, workpiece_id
